description:
Start rendering every output of the reel. SPENDS CREDITS: only call after showing the user ez_reel_quote and getting their go-ahead, and pass confirmCost: true. A reel with an MLS output also needs the user's MLS attestation: show them the text below word for word and pass mlsAttestation: true only if they agree. Async; poll ez_reel_status.

MLS attestation: Before accessing your MLS-compliant video link, please confirm: (1) The physical structure, dimensions, and permanent features of the property are accurately represented and have not been altered; (2) Any AI-generated or virtually staged elements (furniture, decor, landscaping, lighting effects, etc.) will be clearly labeled as "AI Modified." (3) Original, unaltered versions of any digitally altered images will be made accessible to prospective buyers as required by applicable law and MLS rules; (4) You have not used this content to add, remove, or alter structural features, views, or permanent fixtures of the property. By agreeing, you confirm that you are solely responsible for ensuring compliance with your local MLS guidelines, NAR Code of Ethics Articles 2 and 12, California AB 723 (if applicable), and all other federal, state, or local laws governing AI-generated real estate marketing content. Reel Estate does not review, approve, or guarantee the compliance of user-generated content.

confirmCost.description: Set true only after the user has seen and accepted the quote.

mlsAttestation.description: Only for a reel with an MLS output, and only after the user has read the MLS attestation in this tool's description and agreed to it. Never set it on the user's behalf.

name: ez_reel_submit
title: Render an EZ Reel
